question: A man driving a car at a speed of 21 km/hr crosses a bridge in 18 minutes. Find the length of the bridge.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Speed** = 21 km/hr

**Time** = 18 minutes = 18/60 hours = 0.3 hours

**Distance (Length)** = **Speed** × **Time**

⇒ 21 × 0.3 = 6.3 km

**∴ The correct answer is 6.3 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3412edc165f2aa467fce7ef73ebcf8c81b2710f45852ad14cf96d3e1a9ce053.png] 

**Given:**

**Speed** of the car = 21 km/hr

**Time** taken to cross = 18 minutes

**Formula Used:**

**Distance** = **Speed** × **Time**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Convert **Time** into hours: 18 minutes = 18/60 hours

⇒ **Time** = 3/10 hours = 0.3 hours

⇒ **Length of bridge** = 21 km/hr × 0.3 hours

⇒ **Length of bridge** = 6.3 km

**∴ The correct answer is 6.3 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert minutes to hours, divide by 60.

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, relative speed is the difference. In opposite directions, it is the sum.

Average Speed

For the same distance covered at speeds x and y, **Average Speed** = 2xy/(x + y).</p
